title: feat(platform-objects): sys_organization declares a name/logo-only rename action at the record header
body:
Fixes #24271

Clause-②: yes

Dispatched by the `domain:services` seat 1 (seat post #6021), claim `6248546668` as amended by the fork ruling `6248721024`. Branch `claude/issue-24271-organization-rename-door`.

## What

`sys_organization` declares `rename_organization` ("Rename Organization"), so an organization record page can rename the organization. The maintainer's question that filed the card: 「组织 slug 可以改，但是名称不能改吗」.

- **The action.** `type: 'api'`, `target: '/api/v1/auth/organization/update'`, `recordIdParam: 'organizationId'`, `bodyShape: { wrap: 'data' }`, `requiresFeature: 'multiOrgEnabled'`, `locations: ['record_header', 'list_item']`. Its params are `name` (required, `defaultFromRow`) and `logo` (`defaultFromRow`). It has no `slug` param. It also carries `variant: 'secondary'` like its header siblings, `mode: 'edit'` like `update_organization`, icon `pencil`, and the success message "Organization renamed".
- **The header order (ruled).** It is declared before `change_slug`. Both sort at `order` 0, so declaration order breaks the tie. The record header's inline row is now `invite_user`, `set_active_organization`, `rename_organization`. `change_slug` folds into the `⋯` overflow, and `leave_organization` (`order: 1`) stays last. The `leave_organization` comment that names the inline row is updated. So is the `actions` block's header comment: it said better-auth's columns are edited "ONLY through `update_organization`", and it now names both doors.
- **Unchanged:** `update_organization` keeps `name`, `slug` and `logo`, its target and `list_item` alone. It stays the slug door of a composition without the cloud orchestrator. `change_slug` is not edited. Nothing in `plugin-auth` changes.
- **Translations.** The four bundles were regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=platform-objects`. The zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES values are translated: 重命名组织 / 组织已重命名, 組織名を変更 / 組織名を変更しました, Renombrar organización / Organización renombrada. A second extract then dropped the six provenance rows the first one had seeded, so no copied English leaf ships.

## The spec row (the contract face)

The only spec edit is one line in `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`. It adds `'sys_organization.actions.rename_organization'` to `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.multiOrgEnabled.gatedInputs`, beside `update_organization`'s row.

- **What it books.** `requiresFeature: 'multiOrgEnabled'` lowers at parse time to `visible: features.multiOrgEnabled != false`. `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` records, for each flag `/api/v1/auth/config` serves, which spec inputs that flag gates.
- **Why the guard needs it.** `packages/platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts` holds the registry and the objects' gates in lockstep in both directions. Forward: every booked path must carry the flag's predicate. Reverse: every `features.X` reference must be booked. The action without the row is red in the reverse direction; the previous round measured it (`sys_organization.actions.rename_organization is booked in multiOrgEnabled.gatedInputs: expected false to be true`). The row without the action is red in the forward direction. So the two land together.
- **What it does not do.** It adds no schema key, no enum value, no `requiresFeature` value and no flag. `check:api-surface` and `check:authorable-surface` are green with no regenerated artifact. `@objectstack/spec` takes a `patch`. Precedent: `b0a1df044` booked `sys_organization.actions.invite_user` the same way.

## Premises, verified before any edit

- **P1 holds** (better-auth 1.7.3, installed). `organization/update` takes `data` as a `.partial()` object where `name` and `slug` are optional and `logo` is nullish (`dist/plugins/organization/routes/crud-org.mjs`). The slug-taken check runs only when `data.slug` is a string. `adapter.updateOrganization` writes `...data` plus `metadata`, so a body without `slug` leaves the column alone. **Measured on a boot:** a name-only body answered 200 and returned the old slug, and the booted pin below reads the slug back unchanged after a name and logo rename.
- **P3 holds.** plugin-auth's `beforeUpdateOrganization` returns at its first line when no slug is sent (`auth-manager.ts:3607`–`:3610`). The ADR-0092 D2 identity write guard passes better-auth adapter writes: the adapter's writes run as attributed system, so `isUserContextWrite` is false. better-auth grants `organization: ['update']` to `owner` and `admin` (`access/statement.mjs`), not to `member`. **Measured on a boot for the owner:** the creator's rename answered 200. The admin grade is a source reading.

## Tests

All on head `1c3722ca1` unless noted.

- **Declaration pin**, new: `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization-rename-action.test.ts`, 8 tests. It pins the params (exactly `name` and `logo`), the locations, the target, `recordIdParam` and `bodyShape` (equal to `update_organization`'s), and the lowered gate. It pins one door per field: the only `record_header` action that writes through `organization/update` is the rename, and it collects no slug. It pins the header order, with the rename inline and `change_slug` past the inline budget. Controls: `update_organization` and `change_slug` unchanged.
- **Matrix row:** `platform-objects.test.ts`'s feature-gate lowering matrix gains `rename_organization` at `features.multiOrgEnabled != false`.
- **Booted pin**, new: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/organization-rename-door.dogfood.test.ts`, 2 tests. It boots the showcase with `multiTenant: 'posture-only'`, creates an organization, builds the request from the REGISTERED action the way the console's api runner does, renames it, and reads `slug` back unchanged. `organization-update-door.dogfood.test.ts` ran beside it as the control: 11 of 11 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 76 passed (76)`, `Tests 1176 passed (1176)`. The package's `typecheck` exits 0, and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new test.
- `@objectstack/spec`: `vitest run --project local` gives `Test Files 694 passed (694)`, `Tests 21040 passed | 1 todo`. `typecheck` exits 0. The `repo` project is CI's.
- `plugin-auth` `src/public-feature-registry.test.ts` (the served-key drift guard): 5 of 5 passed.
- **Ablation, once** (through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). A `slug` param was planted in `rename_organization` and the anchor count went 1 to 0. The declaration pin then answered `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed`: "expected [ 'name', 'slug', 'logo' ] to deeply equal [ 'name', 'logo' ]" and "rename_organization sends a slug to better-auth". The restore was proven by blob equality: `16a3dce65796` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The pin imports the object from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

## Gates

The local subset is `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` over this diff: 88 commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe. 87 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3): it reads every workspace package's `dist/`, and eight packages outside this diff's build closure have none. It is recorded NOT-MEASURED, and CI runs it. The `--ran` reconciliation reads `88 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 87 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`. The local-only `check:dev-prereqs` passed after the spec build.

## Acceptance notes

- **`change_slug` in the open-source composition, measured:** `POST /api/v1/cloud/organizations/{id}/change-slug` answers `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` on a booted showcase. On the stock single-org boot, `/auth/config` serves `multiOrgEnabled: false`, so the action is hidden there. On the `posture-only` boot it serves `true`, so the record page offers `change_slug` (now in the overflow) and the click answers that 404. This is handed to the seat as a finding, and nothing is changed here.
- **The second slug door at the API level on a cloud composition:** better-auth `organization/update` still accepts `data.slug`, and `beforeUpdateOrganization` refuses it only while active environments exist. The record page no longer reaches it (the rename sends no slug). The API door is objectstack-ai/cloud#3000's to carry.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-organization.page.ts`'s header comment lists "Set Active, Edit, Delete, Leave" as the record-header actions. Edit and Delete are `list_item` only. This is comment drift, outside this claim's file surface, and is left as it is.
- The cloud organization page lists its header actions explicitly. It gains this action in its own card once cloud's framework pin carries it.
